actions.pass_rule: all endpoints reachable for fixed sample; every observed split has basis-consistent unadjusted close/raw shares or row UNKNOWN; no unexplained systematic corruption

availability: pre-open acceptance same session; acceptance during/after session next regular session

daily.denominator: XNYS sessions within proven listing interval; documented halt/suspension separately reported, never silently removed

entitlement_under_test: Massive Stocks Developer active credential, verified by live responses not pricing copy
inactive_rule: dated active=true CS snapshot defines membership at T; later inactivity never removes earlier membership; absence is UNKNOWN, not inferred delisting
pass_criteria: at least two later-inactive securities demonstrably appear in a past universe
ticker/security identity stable for fixed mutation audit
actions do not systematically corrupt cap
purpose: paid entitlement and survivorship coverage feasibility; no returns

sample.remainder_rule: union eligible dated snapshots keyed by security_id; sort SHA256(seed|security_id|first_seen_date|first_ticker), take first 32 excluding mandatory identities

verdicts.FAIL: entitlement or sources cannot realistically build required panel
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: path exists but one or more critical criteria unproven
